```{r render-info}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Provenance for the bottom of every report: which source produced this HTML,
# when, and from where. Emitted as an HTML comment, so it is invisible on the
# page and readable only in view-source. Note that "invisible" is not "private":
# the values are still served in full to anyone who opens the file.
#
# Shared and unfrozen, like _footer.qmd and _analytics.qmd, because it describes
# the render rather than the analysis. Every value is read at render time.
render_info <- local({
  # Returns the command's stdout, or character(0) if git is missing, this is
  # not a repository, or the command fails.
  git_out <- function(...) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(
      try(system2("git", c(...), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
    )
    if (inherits(out, "try-error") || !is.null(attr(out, "status"))) {
      character(0)
    } else {
      out
    }
  }
  first <- function(x, fallback = "unknown") if (length(x)) x[1] else fallback

  # A double hyphen anywhere inside an HTML comment ends it early and spills the
  # rest onto the page. Branch names may legally contain one, so collapse runs.
  safe <- function(x) gsub("-{2,}", "-", x)

  commit <- first(git_out("rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"))
  # A bare hash misrepresents a render made from an edited working tree, so
  # say so rather than implying the output matches the commit. Quarto writes a
  # transient .rmarkdown beside the .qmd while rendering, so that must be
  # gitignored or this reads as changed on every render, including clean ones.
  if (commit != "unknown" && length(git_out("status", "--porcelain"))) {
    commit <- paste0(commit, "-changed")
  }

  branch <- first(git_out("rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"))
  # A detached HEAD reports as "HEAD", which reads as a branch name but is not.
  if (branch == "HEAD") branch <- "detached"

  list(
    commit = safe(commit),
    branch = safe(branch),
    rendered = safe(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")),
    host = safe(first(Sys.info()[["nodename"]]))
  )
})
```

CanadaLogin Signal Check - render provenance
  rendered:    `r render_info$rendered`
  commit:      `r render_info$commit`
  branch:      `r render_info$branch`
  workstation: `r render_info$host`
-->
